_comment: RATIFIED Acquisition Scorecard ruleset, base structure v1.0. Ratified by Gabriel Goldberg in-session 2026-06-14 (answers to scorecard Q1–Q6; see memory/event_log.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-13-acquisition-scorecard-answers-and-build-plan.md). sourceOfRecord: ora-skills/acquisition-underwriting/SKILL.md v4.45 — STAGE 1 floors (Basis, Yield, IRR) and STAGE 2 row 1 (Basis 25 pts at >=76% discount); clear-height bands + loading door ratio supplied by Gabriel 2026-06-14
_floors_note_rct_v03: VINTAGE RAMP recalibrated 2026-07-14 (Gabriel, governor-level) alongside RCT v03. Was a CLIFF at 0.25/0.30 with cutoff 2000 — both a step function AND calibrated to RCT v02's UNDERSTATED denominator. RCT v03 roughly DOUBLES that denominator, so the old 25-30% floor would have let a Columbus deal pay ~$160/SF and 'clear' — every candidate in the buy-box passes. A FLOOR THAT PASSES EVERYTHING IS NOT A FLOOR. THE FLOOR % AND THE DENOMINATOR ARE A MATCHED PAIR: never move one without re-solving the other. ORA buys at ~35-40% of TRUE all-in replacement cost (a ~64% discount); the legacy '25% discount' framing was an artifact of a wrong denominator, never the strategy.
_scoring_note_basisFullCreditDiscount_rc: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-12 (ruleset 2.0.0, Gabriel in-turn ratification): 0.90 -> 0.76, matching acquisition-underwriting SKILL.md STAGE 2 row 1 ('25 at >=76% discount', recalibrated 2026-07-14 'preserving the same price-equivalent span'). Both values date from the same 2026-07-14 RCT v03 recalibration; they forked. The engine's 0.90 preserved the old PERCENTAGE-POINT gap above the floors (+0.25/+0.30), but RCT v03 roughly doubled the denominator, so a fixed point gap is a different PRICE. The doctrine preserves the PRICE: full credit used to sit at 45% of RCT v02, which is about 22-24% of RCT v03, i.e. a ~76% discount. At 0.90 the engine understated Basis by 6-14 pts (e.g. 70% discount on a 65% floor: 5.0 vs 11.4; 76% on 65%: 11.0 vs 25.0). The fail-closed invariant from the 2026-07-14 refute still holds: assertProductionRuleset throws if basisFullCreditDiscount <= the strictest vintage floor (0.76 > 0.65). Prior value archived in config/archive/acquisition-ruleset.v1.1.0.json.
_process_note_versioning_gap: RESOLVED 2026-07-16. Gabriel's decision (in-turn, 2026-07-16): do the full ceremony, not a documentation-only exception. Executed: (1) the pre-bump v1.0.0 content archived byte-for-byte to config/archive/acquisition-ruleset.v1.0.0.json before any edit; (2) rulesetVersion bumped 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 (minor — re-weighting/recalibration within the existing structure, per the semver bump rule in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-13-acquisition-scorecard-contract.md:264; not a patch since the floor values changed substantively, not a major since no category/sub-score was added or removed); (3) src/contracts/acquisition.ts RULESET_VERSION constant updated in lockstep (single source, both z.literal(RULESET_VERSION) call sites inherit it automatically); (4) ratifiedDate updated to 2026-07-14 — the date the underlying floor/basisFullCreditDiscount values were actually ratified by Gabriel (governor-level, same-session adversarial refute already run, see the notes above), not the 2026-07-16 paperwork date, so ratifiedDate keeps tracking content ratification, not ceremony mechanics. No gate bound, floor value, weight, or band cutoff was touched by this entry itself — this ceremony only catches up the version/archive mechanics to a substantive change that was already ratified two days prior.
_floors_note_irr_v2: RULESET 2.0.0 (Gabriel in-turn ratification 2026-11-12), per acquisition-underwriting SKILL.md v4.45 STAGE 1 'IRR floor' (v4.33, majority-vacant premium v4.40): the floor is the 10-yr UNLEVERED IRR (all-cash, exit at the market exit cap) >= MAX(unleveredIrrFloorMin 10.0%, 10-yr UST + unleveredIrrUstSpread 550 bps), + majorityVacantIrrPremium 100 bps when MORE than majorityVacantSfShare (50%) of the SF is vacant at close. UST = FRED DGS10 trailing 30-day average as of the screen date, supplied as input ust10yr + ustAsOf; unknown UST => tested at 10.0% and flagged [UST UNVERIFIED]. The levered >=15% 5-yr / >=12% 10-yr floor is RETIRED (doctrine: ORA's aggregate LTV is near 19%, so a floor on a 65% LTV refi measured a capital structure the family does not hold). Levered IRR stays an input, reported only, never a floor. This 10% acquisition floor is deliberately ABOVE the 8% portfolio hurdle (capital_config / intel-config HURDLE_RATE); the two are not reconciled by design. Engine floor-miss semantics (a computable miss => KILLED) are unchanged in 2.0.0; Ruling 5 flag-not-kill is a separate open decision.

The filename keeps its v1 stem (base-structure lineage) so every import path is unchanged. Also: yield floor is now STRICT (> 8%), per SKILL.md 'stabilized YoC >8%' — value unchanged.
